finalText:
Root cause found. Timeline:

**02:14:07** — Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` dropped: `ECONNREFUSED`. API fell back to direct store reads (cache layer degraded).

**02:14:08 onward** — Cache miss storm hits store directly, no cache buffer. Store overload, requests timing out at 5000ms across api/worker-1/worker-2/scheduler, repeating every ~2s for 17 min straight.

**02:14–02:31** — Queue depth climbs steady, no drain: 52 → 568 (max configured 500, breached ~02:25:48 at depth 400, kept climbing past limit unchecked).

**02:14–02:31, every ~2min** — 12 redis reconnect attempts (0 through 12), all `ECONNREFUSED` — redis never came back.

**02:31:44** — worker-2 `JavaScript heap out of memory` — unbounded backlog ate memory.

**02:31:45** — supervisor restart worker-2 (exit code 134).

**02:31:52** — api unresponsive too, supervisor kill whole process group. Service down. Log end here — no recovery event logged.

Root cause: Redis at 10.0.0.12:6379 died, app had no circuit breaker/backpressure on cache-miss fallback, queue depth cap (500) not enforced (kept growing to 568), backlog exhausted heap, crashed workers, killed service.

Fix directions: add backpressure/reject when queue depth hits cap instead of just warning, circuit-break store reads on cache-miss storm, alert on first redis ECONNREFUSED not wait for crash.
